newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Prequalified Banerj bidders to be announced today.
newsitem.headline: Prequalified Banerj bidders to be announced today.

text.p: Rio de Janeiro state will announce this afternoon the list of prequalified bidders for the June 17 privatization auction of its bank Banerj, a spokesman for the Finance office said.

So far eight financial institutions have prequalified: Bradesco, Banco Itau, General Electric's GE Capital, BankBoston's Brazil unit, Credit Commerciale de France (CCF) do Brasil, Banco BBA Creditanstalt, Cia de Investimentos Latino-Americana and BCN.
However, only Itau has said it is interested and is likely to participate in the auction. Bradesco said it is still studying whether it will bid, while BankBoston in Brazil said they will not bid.
Cia de Investimentos Latino-Americana will not participate due to concerns that the new owner will have to assume future payroll-related debts.
The other institutions have not announced whether they will pursue the acquisition.
After two failed attempts last year, Rio de Janeiro state plans to privatize Banerj, now formally known as Banco Banerj SA, next Tuesday in a closed-envelope auction on the Rio bolsa.
